0022600090.text: Both the Indiana Pacers and New Orleans Pelicans open their 2026-27 seasons in this game, with the Pacers on the road. Johnny Furphy is out for Indiana after knee surgery, and he averaged 5.1 points and 18.4 minutes per game last season. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1, and Indiana won their most recent meeting 127-119 on January 16, 2026 in Indiana, while ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Pacers a 65% chance to win.
